newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel provident funds suffer withdrawals in June.
newsitem.headline: Israel provident funds suffer withdrawals in June.

text.p: Israeli provident funds suffered net redemptions of 158.4 million shekels in June, down from withdrawals of 250.2 million in May and 1.1 billion in June 1996, the Treasury said on Wednesday.
Since the beginning of the year net withdrawals amounted to 1.4 billion shekels against 11.9 billion in all of 1996.
Provident funds are a popular form of long-term savings with special tax benefits. The funds are major investors in the Tel Aviv stock and bond markets.
Savings accounts also suffered net redemptions in June of 53 million shekels against 257.5 million in May. In June 1996 there were net deposits of 105.2 million.
In the first half of the year there were net redemptions of 1.3 billion shekels from savings accounts against net deposits of 5.4 billion in all of 1996.
